project.name: MIST LLM dispatch
project.description: Placeholder module for the future home of MIST's LLM dispatch + cache layer (LLMService, LLMConfig, LLMCallCache, GeminiApiClient, OllamaApiClient). Carries no source yet — the legacy llm.* classes still live in mist-restest-adapter because they pull in RESTest-specific helpers. The gate for Stage 1.C only requires that this module compile independently of mist-core and restest-core, which it does. Migration of the LLM classes is a follow-up task.
